description: Contract of /api/historical/* before the setup-lab restoration (generated by scripts/gen_historical_manifest.py)

metric.description: best_lap, median_lap, finish_position, grid_position or points

sessions.description: Stored session ids to compare (2 to 24)

body.description: Validate an uploaded file against a mapping, units, policies and metadata without importing it.

file_hash.description: SHA-256 returned by the preview endpoint

anyOf.description: Column_Mapping: ``{standard_field: csv_column}``. Blank names are rejected; 1:1 and existence are checked against the file.

metadata.description: Session_Metadata supplied by the user. An item that is not supplied must be named in ``unavailable``.

units.description: Units of the file's time, speed and distance columns; omitted means seconds, kph and metres.

anyOf.description: The ``csv`` sub-object of a ``provider: "csv_upload"`` import request.

data_type.description: required when the file could be either type

file_hash.description: SHA-256 returned by the preview endpoint

anyOf.description: Column_Mapping: ``{standard_field: csv_column}``. Blank names are rejected; 1:1 and existence are checked against the file.

mapping.description: omitted: the suggested mapping is used

metadata.description: Session_Metadata supplied by the user. An item that is not supplied must be named in ``unavailable``.

replace_existing.description: replace a stored session with the same provider, event, session type, driver and year

tz_offset.description: UTC offset for timestamps that carry none, e.g. +02:00

units.description: Units of the file's time, speed and distance columns; omitted means seconds, kph and metres.

csv.description: csv_upload only: staged file hash, Column_Mapping, units, policies and Session_Metadata

drivers.description: Driver codes to import; empty means all drivers in the session

event.description: Grand Prix name or circuit location, e.g. 'Monza' or 'Italian Grand Prix' (required for openf1)

include_race_data.description: OpenF1 only: also fetch running order, results, grid, gaps, overtakes, team radio and championships

provider.description: Historical data source: OpenF1 (free, no account, 2023 onwards)

race_datasets.description: OpenF1 only: which optional datasets to fetch (race_position, session_result, starting_grid, intervals, overtakes, team_radio, drivers_championship, teams_championship, stints, pit, race_control); omitted means all

refresh_cache.description: OpenF1 only: ignore cached answers and download everything again

session.description: Session type code (FP1, FP2, FP3, Q, S, R) or session name (required for openf1)

year.description: Season year; OpenF1 historical data is available from 2023 onwards (required for openf1; csv_upload takes it from csv.metadata)

schema.description: re-download even if this session is already stored

points.description: Size of the common distance grid used for the time delta

body.description: Selection and Setup_Configuration of a Setup_Link submission (validated by LabService.setup_link, which names every problem).
